verdicts.reason: A: the 'Find It Near You' CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill and been pushed to the very top, jammed in with the Back by Demand, Free Delivery and Summer Only pills. The decorative circle no longer frames the shoe; it sits behind the headline. GROVE now sits below the headline, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty. B: it has the same detached circle behind the headline, the shoe is undersized and floats in a big empty band, and the CTA and badges are a cramped, tiny cluster. Still, B's top-to-bottom order (headline, product, action) suits the story format better, so it is the less bad of the two.
